label: 8.2c Hosted Payment Pages
openQuestions: HPP-01..06: hash recipe, AMOUNT/DATETIME formats and full RESPONSECODE set live in Payroc skill references not reproduced here; certifier should pull exact values
HPP-02: UAT decline trigger not documented
WN-21..29: WN id range chosen to avoid direct-api WN-01..11; reassign if the catalogue collides
WN HPP production URLs and validation retry policy not documented
Test Tag length vs ORDERID 24-char limit

scenarios.title: HPP sale approved and receipt verified
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the signed form POST loads the page and the receipt hash is validated.
steps: Compute the request HMAC per the Payroc authenticate-your-requests reference and reproduce the documented example hash first.
POST the form to /merchant/paymentpage; pay with a test card.
On the receipt redirect, verify the response hash before trusting RESPONSECODE.
Persist UNIQUEREF.
scenarios.expected: Receipt carries RESPONSECODE approval and UNIQUEREF; response hash verifies.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Hash recipe, AMOUNT and DATETIME formats must come from the Payroc reference, not memory. Branch on the full RESPONSECODE approval set. ORDERID length limits apply.

scenarios.title: HPP declined card
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a decline is handled on the receipt page.
steps: POST the form and pay with the documented decline trigger.
Verify the response hash; read RESPONSECODE.
scenarios.expected: RESPONSECODE decline value (D per skill examples); order not fulfilled.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)

scenarios.title: HPP invalid hash rejected
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a tampered request hash is refused.
steps: POST the form with an incorrect HASH.
scenarios.expected: The hosted page returns an error and no transaction is created.
scenarios.pitfalls: Exact error presentation not documented in the skill.

scenarios.title: HPP pre-authorization and capture
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies preauthpage plus capture via REST using UNIQUEREF.
steps: POST the form to /merchant/preauthpage.
Persist UNIQUEREF durably.
POST /v1/payments/{uniqueRef}/capture with Bearer auth.
scenarios.expected: Receipt approval; capture HTTP 200 with transactionResult approval.
scenarios.pitfalls: Not available with dual pricing, surcharging or convenience fees.

scenarios.title: HPP save card (securecardpage)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies card tokenization on the hosted page and durable storage of CARDREFERENCE.
steps: Compute the save-card hash TERMINALID:MERCHANTREF:DATETIME:ACTION:SECRET (no amount); POST to /merchant/securecardpage with ACTION register and STOREDCREDENTIALUSE.
Verify the receipt hash; persist CARDREFERENCE and MERCHANTREF.
scenarios.pitfalls: Save-card RESPONSECODE set differs from sale (A/E14/E43/E44). Uses the Secure Token URL receipt setting.

scenarios.title: HPP background validation
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the server-to-server validation POST is received and verified.
steps: Register a public validation URL in Self-Care.
Complete a sale and verify the webhook signature.
scenarios.expected: Validation POST received and verified for the transaction.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: sale with receipt and hash validation
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies the signed form POST, receipt response hash and UNIQUEREF capture.
steps: Compute SHA-512 hash TERMINALID:ORDERID:AMOUNT:DATETIME:RECEIPTPAGEURL:VALIDATIONURL:SECRET (omit absent fields).
POST to /merchant/paymentpage; pay with the Worldnet test card.
Verify response hash TERMINALID:ORDERID:AMOUNT:DATETIME:RESPONSECODE:RESPONSETEXT:SECRET; fulfil only on RESPONSECODE A; store UNIQUEREF.
scenarios.expected: RESPONSECODE A, UNIQUEREF present, hash verifies.
scenarios.pitfalls: Multi-currency terminals add CURRENCY to the hash. DATETIME format DD-MM-YYYY:HH:MM:SS:SSS. ORDERID max 24.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: decline, referral simulation
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies non-approval responses are handled.
steps: Run HPP sales with amounts ending .01 (declined), .02 (referral), .03 (CVV failure).
scenarios.expected: RESPONSECODE D or R; order not fulfilled.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: background validation
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies the validation URL receives the POST and replies exactly OK.
steps: Enable the Validation URL on the terminal or send VALIDATIONURL.
Complete a sale; verify hash; reply with plain text OK.
scenarios.expected: Transaction not flagged not validated or expired.
scenarios.pitfalls: Retry cadence is not documented. Not supported for bank transfer.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: pre-authorization and capture
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies preauthpage and capture via REST or Selfcare.
steps: POST to /merchant/preauthpage.
Capture via PATCH /api/v1/transaction/payments/{uniqueReference}/capture.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: secure token registration
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies securecardpage registration returns CARDREFERENCE.
steps: POST to /merchant/securecardpage with ACTION register (hash TERMINALID:MERCHANTREF:DATETIME:ACTION:SECRET).
Verify the response hash and store CARDREFERENCE and MERCHANTREF.
scenarios.testData: Needs a full Worldnet test account (not shared sandbox)
scenarios.pitfalls: E-codes overlap between token and subscription pages.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: subscription registration
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies subscriptionpage registration using an existing secure token.
steps: POST to /merchant/subscriptionpage/register with CARDREFERENCE or SECURECARDMERCHANTREF (not both), STARTDATE and plan fields.
Verify response hash; RESPONSECODE A or C.
scenarios.testData: Needs a full Worldnet test account

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: 3-D Secure
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies HPP 3DS is handled by the page when enabled on the terminal.
steps: Enable 3DS on the terminal; send email (mandatory).
Complete a 3DS sale on the HPP.
scenarios.expected: Sale completes with authentication result recorded.
scenarios.testData: 3DS test cards not documented (confirm with Worldnet)

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: Apple Pay / Google Pay buttons
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies wallet buttons appear and complete on the HPP (Elavon terminals only).
steps: Enable wallets on the terminal (Apple store name and certificate; Google domain).
Complete a wallet payment from the HPP.
scenarios.expected: Wallet payment approved on the receipt.

scenarios.title: Worldnet HPP: bank transfer option
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies PAYMENTOPTIONS and SECCODE on the shared payment page.
steps: POST with PAYMENTOPTIONS BANK_TRANSFER or CARD_AND_BANK_TRANSFER and SECCODE.
Complete a bank transfer.
scenarios.testData: Bank transfer sandbox data not documented
scenarios.pitfalls: Bank transfer request hash omits VALIDATIONURL; background validation unsupported.
